_readme: Single source for every business claim that depends on Nav's confirmation (Batch 1 audit). Page text, FAQ answers, titles, descriptions and JSON-LD reference these as {{fact:key}} or {{fact:key.field}}. status: confirmed = shown as written; pending = safe wording shown until Nav answers; removed = renders nothing. When Nav answers: edit the entry here (and see docs/client/batch-1/NAV-CONFIRMATIONS.md for claims that can be restored).

freeOnsiteEstimates.long: Free onsite estimates are available. Call or send an enquiry and we’ll review your items and pickup details.

curbsideDiscount.text: 10% off when the items to be removed are already placed at the curb or driveway. Ask our team to confirm offer eligibility
curbsideDiscount.short: 10% off items already at the curb or driveway

bedBugScope.text: We wrap affected furniture, bag smaller affected items where appropriate, wear shoe covers, and remove and carefully dispose of the items. We don’t provide pest treatment; a pest-control professional handles treatment. Call us so we can check the items and any building rules before booking.

minimumPrice.question: Answers A1.3
minimumPrice.text: Junk Load from C$125 (1/16 load, 1 cubic yard). The final quote depends on the items, access and work required and will be confirmed before removal begins

quoteText.question: Answers A1.6, A1.7
quoteText.text: Contact us for a quote based on the items, access and removal requirements.
quoteText.explain: Load volume and type of material, stairs or long carries, disassembly, specialist handling, additional labour and availability may affect the final quote. Any taxes and job-specific charges are explained before you approve the quote.

sameDay.question: Answers B2.1 + Manisha follow-up, 18 Nov 2026
sameDay.text: Same-day pickup may be available depending on the job, location and crew availability

scheduling.question: Answers A3.4, B2.2 + Manisha follow-up, 18 Nov 2026
scheduling.text: We’ll call you to agree a pickup day and arrival window. Weekend pickups are available, subject to scheduling.

reviews.question: Answers B8.1 (omit until a verified widget/source)

businessHours.question: Manisha follow-up, 18 Nov 2026 (phone hours only; days not stated)

recycling.question: Answers B4.1
recycling.text: We aim to recycle or donate suitable items where practical; disposal depends on item type and local facilities

propertyProtection.question: Answers B3.3
propertyProtection.text: We take care when moving items through your property and discuss access before removal

accessCoordination.question: Answers B6.5
accessCoordination.text: Please arrange elevator or loading-dock approval with your building, unless we’ve agreed to coordinate it on the call. Tell us about stairs, elevators and loading docks when you enquire.

retainedItems.question: Answers B6.1, B6.3
retainedItems.text: Tell us which items should be removed, and we’ll discuss the scope before starting. If our crew comes across anything that looks valuable, they’ll check with you before removing it.

pestProfessional.text: For treatment, please speak to a licensed pest-control professional.

dataSecurity.question: Answers B5.1
dataSecurity.text: Please arrange your own data removal before pickup. Our service is pickup and appropriate downstream handling; we don’t provide data erasure or data-destruction certificates.

utilityDisconnection.question: Answers B5.5-B5.7
utilityDisconnection.text: Please arrange qualified gas, electrical and water disconnection where required before pickup. We’ll discuss draining, power isolation and access before we accept the job.

permits.question: Answers B5.9
permits.text: Permit requirements, where applicable, must be confirmed before work begins. Who arranges them is agreed for each job.

eviction.question: Answers B6.6
eviction.text: The landlord or property manager must confirm their legal right to remove the items before we start. We don’t provide legal advice; for legal questions, please speak to a lawyer or paralegal.

fullLoadPrice.question: Answers A1.4
fullLoadPrice.text: A full Junk Load (16 cubic yards) is C$655

pricingIntro.question: Answers – pricing language
pricingIntro.text: See estimated load-size pricing for standard junk removal. Select a load size to view the corresponding rate. The final quote depends on the items, access and work required and will be confirmed before removal begins.
pricingIntro.extra: Additional handling, heavy materials or labour beyond the included allowance, where applicable, will be explained before you approve the quote. Applicable taxes and any job-specific charges will be identified in the final quote.

nextAvailable.question: Answers B5.13
nextAvailable.text: Contact us to check the next available pickup.

concreteScope.question: Answers B5.11
concreteScope.text: Concrete removal and related work can be assessed based on site conditions and scope.

carpetScope.question: Answers B5.14
carpetScope.text: Tell us about the carpet and underlay; we’ll confirm what removal is included in your quote.

medicalOffice.question: Answers B5.3
medicalOffice.text: Contact us to discuss acceptable non-hazardous items.

hazardous.question: Answers B5.8
hazardous.text: We can’t take hazardous materials such as paint or chemicals. Send us an enquiry and we’ll check which non-hazardous contents we can remove.

labourJunk.question: Rate card
labourJunk.text: 1/2 Hour of Labour Included Per 1/4 Load.

labourBed.question: Rate card
labourBed.text: 1 Hour of Labour Included Per 1/2 Load.

callbackNote.question: Answers A3.6
callbackNote.label: Preferred time for a callback (optional)
callbackNote.text: We’ll contact you to discuss availability. This does not reserve or confirm a pickup appointment.

insuranceDocs.question: Answers B3.1
insuranceDocs.text: Live Junk Free is licensed and insured. Commercial customers and property managers can contact our team about documentation

cleanupScope.question: Answers B6.2
cleanupScope.text: We remove the agreed items; light sweeping or cleanup is included only if it's agreed in your quote

siteWorkScope.question: Answers B5.10, B5.11
siteWorkScope.text: Soil, dirt and debris removal can be assessed based on site conditions and scope. Excavation, grading and backfilling aren't promised as part of removal

weekendPickup.question: Manisha follow-up, 18 Nov 2026
weekendPickup.text: Weekend pickups are available, subject to scheduling

taxNote.question: Manisha follow-up, 18 Nov 2026
taxNote.text: Displayed load rates exclude applicable taxes

structuralDemolition.question: Manisha follow-up, 18 Nov 2026
structuralDemolition.text: Structural or attached demolition work is subject to assessment and isn’t guaranteed for every project
